title: Sha'ar HaGilgulim (The Gate of Reincarnations)
author: Chaim Vital (Sefaria Community trans)
description: Chaim Vital records teachings on the soul, reincarnation and spiritual repair within Lurianic Kabbalah. The Gate of Reincarnations explores how individual lives are understood within a wider process of restoration.
